text: dsh-session-workspace-organizer 是面向 DSH Web 和 Desktop 的工作区管理插件。它在设置页提供工作区迁移、会话整理和删除操作，为新会话创建独立输出目录，并支持移动空闲会话。迁移会更新会话日志中的工作目录；标题栏还可重启 DSH。适合希望整理会话产物与工作区的用户，无需 API 密钥。

dsh-session-workspace-organizer manages DSH workspaces and sessions. It supports workspace moves, session organization, deletion, and separate output folders. It moves idle sessions and updates log paths during workspace moves. A header control restarts DSH. No API key is required.

dsh-session-workspace-organizer 的功能「为新会话建立输出目录」：会话启动时在工作区的 sessions/ 下创建按日期和标题命名的目录，并加入会话提示，引导新建产物保存在这里。
dsh-session-workspace-organizer 的功能「迁移工作区」：在工作区设置中选择目标父目录和新名称，插件迁移工作区文件，并更新会话日志的 cwd。
dsh-session-workspace-organizer 的功能「移动会话」：从设置页选择一个或多个空闲会话和目标工作区，可先预览无法自动归属的文件再指定去向。
dsh-session-workspace-organizer 的功能「预览并删除会话」：先查看会话日志、专属目录及可选的会话写入文件，再删除单个或批量的空闲会话。
dsh-session-workspace-organizer 的功能「整理工作区结构」：创建 sessions/ 标准目录与说明文件；可选择将工作区根目录的普通散件归档到按日期命名的目录。

> A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin: move a workspace folder to a new location, give every new session its own output folder, and restart the desktop app from the header.

English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

dsh-session-workspace-organizer README · dsh-session-workspace-organizer：DSH binds each session to a workspace directory, and every session of that workspace shares it — so scripts, logs, downloads and screenshots from unrelated conversations pile up in the same place. This plugin adds four things on top of that model, without patching DSH itself:

dsh-session-workspace-organizer README · dsh-session-workspace-organizer：1. **Relocate a workspace** — move the folder to another path or disk and take its sessions with it. Every session log's header `cwd` is rewritten to the new path, so sessions keep working and stay listed under the new workspace.
2. **One output folder per session** — each new or resumed session gets `<workspace>/sessions/<YYYY-MM-DD>_<title>/`, the model is told (through a session-scoped system prompt) to write its artifacts there, and a `write` that would create a file at the workspace root asks for confirmation first.
3. **Session management** — move idle sessions to another workspace, or delete them (with a dry-run preview), optionally together with the files they created.
4. **Header restart** — a restart button that ends and relaunches the whole DSH process, with a confirmation dialog, a busy-work guard and a progress layer instead of a frozen page.

dsh-session-workspace-organizer README · dsh-session-workspace-organizer：Tested with DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2` on Windows. Host code uses Node built-ins only; the client is a hand-written CommonJS bundle, so there is no build step.

dsh-session-workspace-organizer README · local development checkout：Removing the plugin leaves the `sessions/` folders and their files alone.
dsh-session-workspace-organizer README · Where the UI lives：**Settings → Workspaces** (the section title follows the DSH language: `工作区` in Chinese). Three things live there:

dsh-session-workspace-organizer README · Move workspace：Pick a registered workspace, choose a target parent folder and type the new folder name.

The plugin then performs a **strict relocation**:

dsh-session-workspace-organizer README · Move workspace：**Hard requirement:** the workspace being moved must have no running session, because session logs are append-only and a live write handle cannot be rewritten safely. Open a conversation in **another** workspace and trigger the move from there. If sessions are still running, a dialog lists them (title + id) and offers to cancel their turns, wait for them to settle, and continue with the copy path — unless the session you are typing in is itself in the target workspace, which always has to be moved from elsewhere.

dsh-session-workspace-organizer README · Move workspace：If the old path was DSH's launch directory, the plugin also switches the process working directory and the sandbox fallback root, but desktop shortcuts or launcher configuration still have to be updated by hand.

dsh-session-workspace-organizer README · Organize structure：Creates `sessions/` and `sessions/README.md` when missing. With **move loose files** ticked, ordinary files sitting at the workspace root are moved into `sessions/<date>_整理/`; dotfiles, `README.md`, `AGENTS.md` and common project manifests are left where they are.

dsh-session-workspace-organizer README · Sessions：- **Move to workspace…** — moves idle sessions (single or batch) into another workspace: their logs, their `sessions/` folder with everything inside it, and files the session wrote through `write`/`edit` elsewhere inside the source workspace.
- **Unresolved files (single move)** — click **Preview unresolved files** before moving. The plan lists unmarked legacy session folders, relative write paths (write-time cwd unknown), files outside the source workspace, target conflicts, and an optional project folder. For each row choose **Target session folder**, **Target workspace root**, **Custom directory…**, or **Cancel this item** (default). Known files move automatically; canceled items stay where they are.
- **Legacy folders/projects** — the optional **Legacy session folder** and **Project folder** fields merge/move those explicitly. Conflicting files keep the target file and get a source-tagged copy such as `verify.COT中文翻译插件.md`; nothing is overwritten.
- **Delete** — permanent deletion of idle sessions, with a **preview** first that lists the log, the session folder and any external files that would go away. Files written by that ses

dsh-session-workspace-organizer README · Restart from the header：The restart button in the conversation header ends and relaunches the **whole application**, so every cached service, plugin and module is rebuilt from disk — unlike a page refresh.

dsh-session-workspace-organizer README · Restart from the header：- **It asks first.** Clicking opens a confirmation dialog that says the app will close and start again and that running work is interrupted. Escape, the backdrop and Cancel all dismiss it.
- **Live work is protected.** While a session is generating, a turn is queued or a background job is running, the confirm button becomes a red *Restart anyway* that is no longer the default; the safe choice stays the easy one. `{"force": true}` overrides the gate server-side, and nothing malformed ever counts as force.
- **Progress instead of a frozen page.** A full-screen layer with a two-ring spinner, an indeterminate bar and a status line is drawn directly on `document.body`, so it survives the React tree being torn down. A failed restart flips it to a red state that names the error instead of spinning forever.
- **No native error dialog.** DSH Desktop treats any Host child exit as fatal and raises an OS message box that cannot be covered from the renderer. The helper therefore ends the Electron main process first, lets the Host follow through its own IPC disconnect, then relaunches the app once the tree is gone — and it verifies

dsh-session-workspace-organizer README · Restart from the header：`GET /workspace-organizer/restart` reports whether a restart is possible (`mode`, `revision`, `lastError`), and answers `409` with `busy: true` while work is live.

dsh-session-workspace-organizer README · Configuration：Override the plugin row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: workspace-organizer
  config:
    sessionFolders: true      # create the per-session output folder
    guardRootWrites: true     # confirm before creating files at the workspace root

dsh-session-workspace-organizer README · Safety notes：- Strict relocation **deletes the old directory**. It only runs after the blocker precheck, it writes the new location and the rewrites before deleting anything, and it rolls back when a step fails — but there is no "keep both folders" mode by design. Use a copy migration (the automatic fallback) if you want the old directory kept.
- Rewriting session logs is an **offline** operation. Restart DSH after moving, so the session list, search index and persistence caches re-read the new path.
- A workspace containing symlinks or junctions is refused for the copy fallback (to avoid duplicating cycles or losing links); same-disk rename is unaffected.
- Sessions that were already open before the plugin was installed get their folder on the next resume, not retroactively.
- All destructive commands require a confirmation token minted by the check/preview step; the client never sends a bare "delete".

dsh-session-workspace-organizer README · Compatibility and limitations：- DSH `0.2.x` (Web and Desktop profiles that include `dsh-base` + `dsh-web-app`).
- Busy-handle handling keys off Windows error codes; on other platforms the copy fallback is simply the normal path.
- Movement and deletion run as commands recorded in an open conversation, so a session must be open; that session must not belong to the workspace being moved.
- The sidebar's workspace "…" menu has no extension slot in DSH, which is why the entry point lives in Settings.

dsh-session-workspace-organizer README · How it works：| Layer | File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host | `index.js` | Registers the `workspace-relocate-check` / `workspace-relocate-strict` / `workspace-organize` / `session-relocate-plan` / `session-relocate` / `session-relocate-batch` / `session-delete-preview` / `session-delete` / `session-delete-batch` commands; `agent/created` builds the session folder and the scoped prompt; `session/event` renames it on title change; `tools/pre-execute` guards root writes; serves the restart route |
| Host | `lib/fs-ops.js` | Directory move (same-disk rename, cross-disk copy + verify + rollback), name sanitizing, loose-file scan |
| Host | `lib/session-logs.js` | zstd first-frame header parsing, `cwd`-only rewrite, later frames untouched, log-directory re-homing |
| Host | `lib/restart.js` | Full-process restart: shell-first shutdown (so no native error dialog), detached relaunch helper, liveness check, bounded restart logs |
| Client | `client.js` | `settings.section` page with the move / organize / sessions dialogs, the header restart button and its confirmation/progress layers, bilingual copy from `locale/*.json` |

dsh-session-workspace-organizer README · Development：```sh
npm run check   # node --check on index.js, client.js and the three lib modules
npm test        # node --test tests/ (path safety, copy/merge, header rewrite, restart routes)
```

No bundler: `lib/` is the committed source, `client.js` is the bundle DSH loads through `window.__ModuleLoader__`. Host changes need a DSH restart; client changes need a page refresh.
